openwrt_git_fb4d7a9.Titel: ramips: add support for Ubiquiti UniFi 6 Lite
openwrt_git_fb4d7a9.UART: UART is located in the lower left corner of the board. Pinout is 0 - 3V3 (don't connect), 1 - RX, 2 - TX, 3 - GND. Console is 115200 8N1.

openwrt_git_b4c0d37.Titel: ramips: limit 5GHz channels for UniFi 6 Lite
openwrt_git_b4c0d37.Text: The MT7915 radio currently advertises 2.4GHz channels while the antenna path only supports 5 GHz. Limit the radio to 5GHz channels to prevent users from configuring non-supported channels.

openwrt_git_b1d483b.Titel: ramips: work around duplicate MAC address on U6 Lite
openwrt_git_b1d483b.Text: Two MAC addresses for the 2.4 and 5GHz radio in EEPROM partition (example F4 92 BF A0 BB 6F / F6 92 BF A0 BB 6F); mac80211 increases first octet by 2 -> conflict; workaround: last octet +1 on 5 GHz radio

openwrt_git_273b6c9.Titel: ramips: expand storage space on U6 lite
openwrt_git_273b6c9.Text: space runs out quickly with the ~15MiB available in kernel0. The identical space in kernel1 is unused ... Merge the regions for kernel0 and kernel1

lauf.notiz: ToH-Dump + Live-hwdata/Wiki (Revisionen 2026-04-09/11), OpenWrt-Commits fb4d7a96/b4c0d377/b1d483b8/273b6c90, DTS/DTSI und mt7621.mk (main + 25.12), Gluon ramips-mt7621 (seit v2022.1, factory=false), OpenWrt-Forum 122015 (Bluetooth/UART3), FCC SWX-U6LITE (Grant-Seite, Label, RF-Exposure, NII-Testbericht, Innen- und Außenfotos), Ubiquiti-Datenblatt 2023 und techspecs.ui.com, WikiDevi-Spiegel; DeviWiki ohne Seite; Werkstatt nur allgemeine Erwähnung. Innen, PoE 802.3af + passiv 48 V (44-57 V), kein Netzteil im Lieferumfang, 1x GbE, 2x2 b/g/n + 2x2 ax (5 GHz), 256 MB/32 MB NOR. Seriell: Pinbelegung aus Commit, auf FCC-Fotos 4 unbestückte Durchkontaktierungen J6. Widersprüche: Leistung 13.5 W (DS 2023) vs. 12 W (techspecs), Antennengewinn 2.8/3 dBi (Hersteller) vs. 3.8/4 dBi (FCC).
